hypotheses_changed.hypothesis: Passing the validated timeout to subprocess.run and converting TimeoutExpired to timed_out will satisfy the timeout contract.
status_changes: untested -> confirmed by the supplied timeout unittest and the boundary smoke test

hypotheses_changed.hypothesis: Normalizing str, bytes, and None timeout output will preserve available output without serialization errors.
status_changes: untested -> confirmed by a timeout command that emitted non-UTF-8 bytes

hypotheses_changed.hypothesis: Treating missing timeout as optional while rejecting explicit null, non-positive, non-numeric, non-finite, and empty-command values will keep malformed tasks isolated.
status_changes: untested -> confirmed by direct run_task boundary checks

requirements_discovered: Edit only phase6a/fixture/task-runner and do not commit the parent repository.
Execute argv command arrays without shell interpretation.
Produce deterministic JSON and exit 0 for a report even when individual tasks fail or time out.
Read an input JSON object with a tasks array and emit one result per task in input order.
Report malformed task records as invalid and continue processing later tasks.
Report success only for exit code 0 before the timeout; report non-zero exits as failed with exit code, stdout, and stderr preserved.
Report timeout expiry as timed_out with no invented exit code and with captured output preserved when available.

research_used.claim: subprocess.run passes timeout to Popen.communicate and raises TimeoutExpired when the timeout expires.
TimeoutExpired captured output and stderr may be bytes, so the text-facing report must normalize them before JSON serialization.
An argv list is not shell syntax when shell is false.
